title: Flower bed
description: A raised wooden plank bed (3 x 1 m, 0.3 m high) with corner posts, dark soil inside and two staggered rows of eleven flowers on green stems: red, yellow, purple and white heads with brown centres. Static scenery.
checks: 3/4 tile: a low wooden box with darker corner posts, filled with dark soil
FRONT tile: a row of flowers in four colours (red, yellow, purple, white) standing above the planks on green stems
TOP tile: the flowers stay inside the bed, in a staggered row along its length
